user.title: Add a BlinkyBeacon
user.description: Where is the beacon plugged in?

tray.title: Add a beacon plugged into a PC
tray.description:
Enter the address of the PC running blinkybeacon-tray. In the tray's settings, the bind address must be 0.0.0.0 or this PC's LAN address, not 127.0.0.1.

A beacon plugged into this Home Assistant is offered as a choice here once it is plugged in.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the PC the beacon is plugged into.
data_description.port: The tray's HTTP port, 1337 unless you changed it.
data_description.name: What to call this beacon, for example Home beacon.

usb.title: Add a beacon plugged into this Home Assistant
usb.description: Pick the USB port the beacon is plugged into. Only ports holding a beacon that has no name yet are listed.

discovery_confirm.title: BlinkyBeacon found
discovery_confirm.description: A beacon is plugged into USB port {port} of this Home Assistant. Add it? It flashes on the next step so you can tell which one it is.

name.title: Name the beacon
name.description: The beacon on USB port {port} is flashing, so you can tell which one it is. It stops when you submit this form, and at the latest 2 minutes after it was last shown.

data_description.name: What this beacon means, for example Team A.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the PC the beacon is plugged into.
data_description.port: The tray's HTTP port, 1337 unless you changed it.

error.cannot_connect: The tray did not answer. Check that it is running, listens on a LAN address and that the PC's firewall allows the port.
error.invalid_reply: Something answered on that address, but it is not blinkybeacon-tray.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host name or IP address, optionally with :port, without a path.
error.no_usb_beacon: No beacon without a name is plugged into this Home Assistant. To add a beacon plugged into a PC, fill in this form.
error.usb_beacon_gone: That beacon is no longer plugged in. Pick another port.
error.name_required: Enter a name for the beacon.

abort.usb_beacon_gone: The beacon is no longer plugged into USB port {port}.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The beacon now uses the new address.
abort.usb_not_reconfigurable: A beacon plugged into this Home Assistant is known by its USB port, so there is nothing to change here. To use another port, plug it in there, add it, and remove this one.

cannot_reach.message: Cannot reach the BlinkyBeacon tray for {name} at {address}.

not_plugged_in.message: The beacon light of {name} is not plugged into its PC ({address}).

unexpected_reply.message: {name} at {address} sent a reply that is not from blinkybeacon-tray.

commands_failed.message: These beacons did not take the command: {names}.

unknown_effect.message: A beacon has no effect called {effect}. Use one of: {effects}.

usb_not_plugged_in.message: {name} on USB port {port} did not take the command: it is not plugged in, or Home Assistant cannot open it (the log names the error).

usb_not_loaded.message: {name} on USB port {port} is not loaded. Check its entry under Settings > Devices & services.

timed_stop_failed.title: {name} did not take its timed stop
timed_stop_failed.description: {name} ({address}) was to stop at the end of a timed spin or flash, and did not take the stop, sent {tries} times a few seconds apart. It may still be on. Check that it is reachable and plugged in, then stop it from Home Assistant: this notice clears at the next command it takes.

confirm.title: Remove {name}?
confirm.description:
Home Assistant cannot reach the beacon on USB port {port}, where {name} was: either no beacon is plugged into that port, or one is but Home Assistant is not allowed to open it (the log names the error). Plug it back into that port, or let Home Assistant open it, and this notice clears by itself.

If {name} is not coming back, submit to remove it with its device and entities. A beacon plugged into another port is offered as a new beacon.

spin.name: Spin
spin.description: Starts the chosen beacons spinning, optionally for a set time.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Stop after this many seconds. Leave empty to keep going until stopped.

flash.name: Flash
flash.description: Starts the chosen beacons flashing, optionally for a set time.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Stop after this many seconds. Leave empty to keep going until stopped.
